title: Full Manual Operation Authorized — Public Health First

fields.subject: URGENT: Level 3 — Public Health Emergency — Immediate Action Required
fields.applicability: City of Millbrook Department of Water & Sewer, all on-site and remote personnel operating under MDWS-ERP-2026 and MDWS-OTSEC-2026
fields.purpose:
The Ohio EPA DDAGW Central District has confirmed a Level 3 public health emergency in Zone 1 due to a confirmed caustic overfeed. The control system has been compromised and cannot be trusted to reflect real-time water quality. The pH of 9.6 and caustic dose of 37 mg/L in Sample 24-1189 exceed safe limits and pose a direct risk of chemical injury. The system's telemetry is no longer reliable. Immediate manual control is required to prevent further exposure.

Failure to maintain full manual operation constitutes a violation of the Safe Drinking Water Act and the Ohio Water Quality Standards.
actions: Immediately suspend all automatic control functions in the RWTP and distribution system.
Operate the plant under full manual control for up to 72 hours with two certified operators on site at all times.
Maintain the Do Not Drink advisory for Zone 1 until further notice and until verification is complete.
Report all manual actions to the Ohio EPA DDAGW Central District via the MDWS-PCP-2026 incident reporting portal within 15 minutes of each change.
Confirm that the HMI, SCADA, and PLC systems are isolated from external access and that no remote sessions are active.
Initiate the OHWARN mutual-aid request for certified backup operators and confirm arrival time within 2 hours.
fields.contact: Questions: contact Carol Dugan, Ohio EPA DDAGW Central District, at (555) 038-7100 or carol.dugan@ohioepa.gov

instructorNote: This inject confirms the final decision to enter full manual operation. Watch for the IC to formally authorize the shift, assign roles, and begin logging on Form OPS-9. Ensure the manual mode transition is documented and that no further automatic control attempts are made.

snapshot.title: Full Manual Operation Authorized — Public Health First

fields.headline: Full Manual Operation Declared
fields.narration: The Director of Water Operations has just made a final decision. She has declared the control system permanently off automation. All automatic control functions are suspended. The plant will now operate in full manual mode for up to 72 hours, with two certified operators on site at all times. The risk of another overfeed — or a failure to detect one — is too high to justify continuing in automatic. The emergency has been elevated to Level 3 under ERP Section 4.4. The OHWARN mutual-aid request has been initiated, and certified backup personnel are being dispatched. The shift will now run under manual control procedures as outlined in ERP Section 7.5.1 and C4.
keyFacts: Full manual operation is now active
Two operators per shift required for 72 hours
fields.expectedAction: The ICS team confirms the new operating mode and updates the incident status in the ERP log. The Operations Section Chief — Plant and the Technical Specialist — SCADA / Cyber validate the manual control handover and begin logging all actions on Form OPS-9.

snapshot.instructorNote: This inject confirms the shift has made the irreversible decision to abandon automation. Watch for whether the team activates the OHWARN call and checks staffing compliance.
